book.smfs.default_book.title: Bloodstained Notes
book.smfs.default_book.author: Unknown
book.smfs.default_book.page1: I might be finished here, I haven't been able to find a way out. If this continues, even the last ghost on me will be taken away. I really regret not retreating earlier, now I don't have the ability to leave even if I want to.
book.smfs.default_book.page2: I absolutely cannot let it get this human skin paper! A ghost with thoughts is extremely terrifying. I can't leave it here, fortunately my last ghost is special and there's still hope to tear open a gap here.
book.smfs.default_book.page3: Although this gap isn't enough for me to leave, it's enough for me to send some things away. If someone is reading these notes, they might find it unbelievable, but please believe that everything I'm saying really happened.
book.smfs.default_book.page4: I've left these notes behind, recording many useful pieces of information I've summarized. Each one could save your life, you must read them all!
book.smfs.default_book.page5: 1. Ghosts exist in this world! And ghosts have just begun to revive, as time passes, there will be more and more of them.
book.smfs.default_book.page6: 2. Ghosts cannot be killed! Ordinary people are extremely fragile in the presence of ghosts, death can come with the slightest carelessness, with no hope at all. To survive supernatural events, you must control a ghost! Only ghosts can deal with ghosts!
book.smfs.default_book.page7: 3. Ghosts have no thoughts, most act on instinct, and have fixed killing rules. It's safe as long as you don't trigger the killing rules. But be careful of [variables].
book.smfs.default_book.page8: 4. Ghost power cannot affect gold. In emergencies, you can use gold to build a 3*3*4 box to hide from ghosts. Or use 8 gold blocks and a chest to craft a golden coffin, which achieves the same effect and is easier to carry.
book.smfs.default_book.page9: 5. The human skin paper is dangerous but also very useful. I originally planned to seal it forever, but it might hold the secret to ending the supernatural era, so I ultimately chose to carry it with me. I never expected to be finished here on this day, forced to send the human skin paper away. Please make good use of it!
book.smfs.default_book.page10: PS. You can view all mod keybinds at [Settings Interface - Options - Key Controls - Key Bindings], including newbie quests, control system, supernatural system, etc. Completing newbie quests can give you lots of resources.
book.smfs.default_book.page11: Terminology explanations: [Deadlock] generally refers to when two ghosts enter a state that cannot be easily recovered from due to supernatural conflicts. In this state, you can use ghost abilities without restraint without revival risk. [Suppression/Silence] generally refers to when a ghost's supernatural power temporarily loses effect, such as when the ghost inside a player falls silent, its abilities cannot be used.
